command:
mkdir -p proof
python3 --version > proof/environment.txt
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install pytest==9.0.2 pytest-timeout pyyaml jsonschema setuptools -e runtime -e runtime/packages/python
.venv/bin/python -m pip freeze >> proof/environment.txt
export PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/agent:$PWD/runtime:$PWD/runtime/packages/python"
export ASTRID_RUNTIME_CHECKOUT="$PWD/runtime"
cd agent
python -m pytest -q --tb=short --junitxml=../proof/pytest.xml tests/test_installer_busy_fence.py tests/test_installer_launchd_cache_window.py tests/test_installer_launchd_stop_handoff.py
